Definition: from G1909 and G5524; to furnish besides, i.e. fully supply, (figuratively) aid or contribute:--add, minister (nourishment, unto).
BiblicalUsage: Epichoregeo means to furnish besides, to supply fully — to add, to minister nourishment. God ministers the Spirit and works miracles among you; He that ministers seed to the sower will minister bread for food; the body grows by the supply of the Head; and we are to add to our faith virtue.
TheologicalSignificance: God supplies and we add: He furnishes the seed and the growth, and our part is to add diligence to what He has already given. I hold that this is the right order — His supply first, my adding second — and reversing it is how I grow weary.
